result.markdown:
For most small businesses in the U.S., **QuickBooks Online is the best overall accounting software**\. However, depending on your business type, budget, and whether you have employees, another option might be a better investment.

Here are my top five recommendations for 2026.

## Best accounting software for small businesses

![Quickbooks Online — Columbus Business Consulting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/z_-lMr1rk7nVCnHpykvHbFlLn1azsDdLq1E5IPLLHaY_8oSNYyauUS0LtpVtMtsr7aGmH36ThTapoKB2Ph5Q3eMVc_UXwvW966z4ZTJF_6xHgqWw4BiwFU5MO1xbGE5oY_mXKemXduz1fPiAwGEyT1jt_IjAl-f9situ1bcy769twmRe-HD-uB1wI8CWqiLV?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. QuickBooks Online** (Best overall)

## \$38+/mo

- Income and expense tracking
- Bank account synchronization
- Invoicing and payment tracking
- Payroll integration
- Financial statements and tax reporting

**Best for\:** Most small businesses, including retail, contractors, and growing companies.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/)

---

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Xero**

## \$27+/mo

- Clean, easy-to-use interface
- Unlimited users
- Bank reconciliation
- Cash flow forecasting
- More than 1,000 integrations

**Best for\:** Businesses with multiple employees or people managing the books.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/us/)

---

![Zoho Books Logo PNG Vector (SVG) Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/4BiXY_WEN49lYCvbGaKDFfpQRd4AylQLrJUAqECUlizaJxfPoT7vHE_aMf89Ai5XDgiicM083l1mRaYjiwKVUSU-hyO3RMNhHn9n_1p9iDfGlD90vd7yixEZXe3uN-cFk5rC7bm4cnrvTfOD__DTiLg0FqR-qg85e1e4wDVsY_7IdvAZqwAqO3vtJfa4QIvd?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho Books**

## \$0–\$20+/mo

- Affordable accounting
- Automated invoicing
- Expense tracking
- Inventory management
- Business workflow automation

**Best for\:** Startups and businesses looking to keep monthly costs low.

[Zoho Books website](https://www.zoho.com/us/books/)

---

![FreshBooks Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RRvX6v49QkXlAnGf7iI3zuYuHq4Y5bCV2ND2uEGJjfjlSbrrgGFSfhAMTnFz47xKgD07CO5bDVnhMBo6jF3Yychs84_UW4qLs93k9PAEnaI8Kmr_xSKldMl1tHK69I4mDHX1xQ085ifzPdaKSnwyxyG_Y5668gw33P8XIfpZgJ8Lv3nST9TCXoqpEHKBFC7o?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. FreshBooks**

## \$23+/mo

- Professional invoices
- Time tracking
- Client management
- Expense tracking
- Project profitability

**Best for\:** Consultants, freelancers, and service-based businesses.

[FreshBooks website](https://www.freshbooks.com/)

---

**5\. Wave**

## Free plan available

- Basic bookkeeping
- Income and expense tracking
- Invoicing

**Best for\:** Solo business owners and very small businesses on a tight budget.

## My recommendation

| Your business situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| General small business | QuickBooks |
| Construction or contracting | QuickBooks |
| Retail or inventory | QuickBooks or Zoho |

| Startup on a budget | Zoho Books |
